prompt: Build a compact ESP32 LoRa sensor board with USB-C power and programming, a LoRa module, temperature and motion sensors, one status LED, reset and boot buttons, battery input, and a few GPIO headers. Use a 2-layer PCB, keep the RF section clean, place sensors away from noisy power parts, and fully route the board neatly with a ground plane.

platforms.name: KiCad
platforms.boardFeatures: ESP32-C3-WROOM-02U with USB-C power and programming; RFM95W-868S2 LoRa module; TMP102 temperature sensor; LIS3DH motion sensor; one status LED; reset and boot buttons; GPIO headers; TPS63001 power regulation; protected 1S LiPo battery input (external charging required, no onboard charger). Two-layer PCB with a ground plane.
